QuestInfo.name: Moren's Class on the Actual Practice
QuestInfo.0: When I visited Moren to learn his new method, he instructed me to attend his class that deals with the actual application of the new method. Oh, so I am actually doing this now...
QuestInfo.1: Moren told me he needs some time to prepare the materials for the class, and told me to talk to him when I'm ready.
QuestInfo.2: I went through Moren's class on the actual application of the new method. This was fun!

0.0: I will be in charge of the actual application of what you have learned in classes! I will show you exactly how the items can be formed through alchemy, step by step! Watch and learn! \nAh! The tuition for the class will be #b10,000 mesos#k, paid in advance! Will you sign up for this class?

yes.0: The class for applied alchemy requires a number of items to be set up and ready to go, so talk to me in a bit!

no.0: Are you short on mesos? How foolish of you to curtail your desire for knowledge because of money!
